definition: to persuade or force someone to do something (get + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: nhờ ai làm gì, bảo ai làm gì
exampleSentence: I'll get Terry to check the wiring for me.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ nhờ Terry kiểm tra hệ thống dây điện giúp tôi.

definition: to employ someone for a short time to do a particular job (hire + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: A city lawyer has been hired to handle the case.
exampleTranslation: Một luật sư thành phố đã được thuê để xử lý vụ việc.

definition: to officially tell someone what to do (instruct + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: chỉ thị cho ai làm gì
exampleSentence: His secretary was instructed to cancel all his engagements.
exampleTranslation: Thư ký của ông ấy được chỉ thị hủy mọi cuộc hẹn.

definition: to politely ask someone to do something (invite + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Anyone interested in contributing articles is invited to contact the editor.
exampleTranslation: Ai quan tâm đến việc đóng góp bài viết xin mời liên hệ biên tập viên.

definition: to cause someone to do something (lead + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: dẫn đến việc ai làm gì
exampleSentence: What led him to kill his wife?
exampleTranslation: Điều gì đã khiến anh ta giết vợ?

definition: to make someone have to do something because of a rule or situation; usually passive (oblige + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The minister was obliged to report at least once every six months.
exampleTranslation: Bộ trưởng bị buộc phải báo cáo ít nhất sáu tháng một lần.

definition: to tell someone that they must do something, using your official power (order + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: ra lệnh cho ai làm gì
exampleSentence: Tom was ordered to pay £300 as compensation.
exampleTranslation: Tom bị yêu cầu trả 300 bảng tiền bồi thường.

definition: to make it possible for someone to do something; formal (permit + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The moon permitted me to see a little way into the distance.
exampleTranslation: Ánh trăng giúp tôi nhìn thấy được một đoạn xa.

definition: to make someone decide to do something, especially by giving reasons (persuade + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I finally managed to persuade her to go out for a drink with me.
exampleTranslation: Cuối cùng tôi cũng thuyết phục được cô ấy đi uống nước với tôi.

definition: to try to make someone do something by making them feel it is their duty (pressure + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: gây áp lực để ai làm gì
exampleSentence: Don't let anyone pressure you to buy something you can't afford.
exampleTranslation: Đừng để ai gây áp lực bắt bạn mua thứ bạn không đủ tiền mua.

definition: to make someone remember something they must do (remind + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Remind me to buy some milk tonight.
exampleTranslation: Nhắc tôi mua sữa tối nay nhé.

definition: to show someone how to do something (teach + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: My father taught me to swim.
exampleTranslation: Bố tôi đã dạy tôi bơi.

definition: to show someone the method for doing something (teach + somebody + how to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: She teaches children how to read.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy dạy trẻ em cách đọc.

definition: to say that someone must do something (tell + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The teacher told the children to sit down quietly.
exampleTranslation: Cô giáo bảo bọn trẻ ngồi xuống yên lặng.

definition: to say what someone must do (tell + somebody + what to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Stop trying to tell me what to do all the time.
exampleTranslation: Đừng lúc nào cũng cố bảo tôi phải làm gì.

definition: to try to persuade someone to do something by making it seem attractive (tempt + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: It would take a lot of money to tempt me to quit this job.
exampleTranslation: Phải có rất nhiều tiền mới cám dỗ được tôi bỏ việc này.

definition: to believe that someone will do something properly (trust + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: tin tưởng ai sẽ làm gì
exampleSentence: Can they be trusted to look after the house?
exampleTranslation: Có thể tin họ trông nhà được không?

definition: to strongly suggest that someone does something (urge + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: She urged me to get in touch with him.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thúc giục tôi liên lạc với anh ta.

definition: to tell someone that something bad may happen so they can avoid it; usually with not (warn + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: cảnh báo ai nên làm gì, đừng làm gì
exampleSentence: I warned you not to walk home alone.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã cảnh báo bạn đừng đi bộ về nhà một mình.

definition: to make someone feel confident and eager to do something (inspire + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: truyền cảm hứng cho ai làm gì
exampleSentence: He inspired many young people to take up the sport.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy truyền cảm hứng cho nhiều bạn trẻ theo đuổi môn thể thao này.

definition: to make someone want to achieve something and work hard for it (motivate + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The profit-sharing plan is designed to motivate the staff to work hard.
exampleTranslation: Chế độ chia lợi nhuận được thiết kế để thúc đẩy nhân viên làm việc chăm chỉ.

definition: to officially suggest someone for a duty or position (nominate + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I nominate John to represent us at the meeting.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đề cử John đại diện cho chúng ta tại cuộc họp.

definition: to ask someone politely or formally to do something; often passive (request + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: All club members are requested to attend the annual meeting.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả thành viên câu lạc bộ được yêu cầu tham dự cuộc họp thường niên.

definition: to force someone to do something (make + somebody + infinitive without to)
exampleSentence: My parents always make me do my homework before I go out.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ tôi luôn bắt tôi làm bài tập trước khi ra ngoài.

definition: to allow someone to do something (let + somebody + infinitive without to)
translation: để cho ai làm gì, cho phép ai làm gì
exampleSentence: Let Johnny have a go on the computer now.
exampleTranslation: Để Johnny dùng thử máy tính bây giờ đi.

definition: to ask or order someone to do something (have + somebody + infinitive without to)
translation: nhờ ai làm gì, bảo ai làm gì
exampleSentence: I'll have Hudson show you to your room.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ nhờ Hudson đưa bạn về phòng.

definition: to notice someone doing something from beginning to end, using your eyes (see + somebody + infinitive without to)
translation: thấy ai làm gì (từ đầu đến cuối)
exampleSentence: I saw him leave a few minutes ago.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy anh ấy rời đi cách đây vài phút.

definition: to notice someone while they are in the middle of doing something (see + somebody + -ing)
exampleSentence: The suspect was seen entering the building.
exampleTranslation: Nghi phạm bị thấy đang đi vào tòa nhà.

definition: to know from a sound that someone does something (hear + somebody + infinitive without to)
exampleSentence: She heard Tom go upstairs.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy nghe thấy Tom đi lên lầu.

definition: to know from a sound that someone is doing something (hear + somebody + -ing)
translation: nghe thấy ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: Jenny could hear them arguing outside.
exampleTranslation: Jenny nghe thấy họ đang cãi nhau bên ngoài.

definition: to look at someone for a period of time and pay attention to what happens (watch + somebody + infinitive without to)
exampleSentence: I watched him go, then went home.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhìn anh ấy đi rồi về nhà.

definition: to look at someone while they are doing something (watch + somebody + -ing)
exampleSentence: Ruth could not bear to watch her parents arguing.
exampleTranslation: Ruth không chịu nổi khi phải nhìn bố mẹ mình cãi nhau.

definition: to realize that someone is doing something, because you see or hear it (notice + somebody + -ing)
translation: nhận ra ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: Did you notice him leaving the party early?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có để ý anh ấy rời bữa tiệc sớm không?

definition: to notice something that happens to you, especially something touching you (feel + somebody + infinitive without to)
exampleSentence: She felt his arms go round her.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy cảm thấy vòng tay anh ôm lấy mình.

definition: to hear by accident what other people are saying (overhear + somebody + -ing)
translation: tình cờ nghe thấy ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: She overheard the management discussing pay rises.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy tình cờ nghe ban quản lý đang bàn về việc tăng lương.

definition: to see someone doing something they did not want you to know about (catch + somebody + -ing)
translation: bắt gặp ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: I caught him reading my private letters.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bắt gặp anh ta đang đọc thư riêng của tôi.

definition: to discover someone in a particular condition or doing something (find + somebody + -ing)
translation: thấy ai đang làm gì, bắt gặp ai đang làm gì
exampleSentence: Often he found her quietly weeping alone.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy thường thấy cô ấy lặng lẽ khóc một mình.

definition: to go away and let someone continue doing something (leave + somebody + -ing)
translation: để ai tiếp tục làm gì, bỏ ai lại đang làm gì
exampleSentence: Never leave children playing near water unattended.
exampleTranslation: Đừng bao giờ để trẻ em chơi gần nước mà không có người trông.

definition: to have the skill or knowledge to do something (know + how to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Do you know how to change a fuse?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có biết cách thay cầu chì không?

definition: to explain to someone how to do something, by doing it yourself or using actions (show + somebody + how to-infinitive)
translation: chỉ cho ai cách làm gì
exampleSentence: Maureen showed Peter how to feed the young animals.
exampleTranslation: Maureen chỉ cho Peter cách cho thú con ăn.

definition: to tell someone about the way to do something in a clear way (explain + how to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The librarian will explain how to use the catalogue system.
exampleTranslation: Thủ thư sẽ giải thích cách dùng hệ thống danh mục.
